question: What was the subject under investigation for setting up the Hunter commission in 1882?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hunter Commission was established in 1882 to investigate and report on the state of education in India.
 
• It was officially known as the Indian Education Commission.
 
• The commission was chaired by Sir William Wilson Hunter, a member of the Indian Civil Service.
 
• The main aim was to assess the efficacy of the existing education system and make recommendations for its improvement.
 
• The Hunter Commission's recommendations led to the promotion of primary education and the establishment of more schools and colleges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Primary Education:**

 
 
• The Hunter Commission emphasized the importance of primary education and recommended that it be made more widely accessible.
 
• It suggested that the government should take responsibility for the expansion and improvement of primary education.
 
 
 
• **Higher Education:**
 
 
• The commission also examined the state of higher education and suggested reforms to improve the quality and reach of colleges and universities.
 
• It recommended the establishment of more universities and colleges to cater to the growing demand for higher education.
 
 
 
• **Technical and Vocational Training:**
 
 
• The Hunter Commission recognized the need for technical and vocational training to support industrial and agricultural development.
 
• It recommended the introduction of technical and vocational courses in schools and colleges.
 
 
 
• **Teacher Training:**
 
 
• It stressed the importance of training teachers to improve the quality of education.
 
• The commission recommended the establishment of teacher training institutions and regular in-service training programs for teachers.
